get.summary: List all consents for current user
get.description: Returns a list of all available consents with their current status for the authenticated admin user. Each consent includes its name, identifier, and current state (requested, accepted, or revoked).

200.description: List of consents with their status

401.description: Unauthorized - User not logged in or invalid session

post.description: Marks the specified consent as accepted for the authenticated admin user.

consent.description: The name of the consent to accept

revision.description: Optional accepted revision. Only the consent definition's latest revision is accepted. When omitted, the latest revision is used automatically.

200.description: Consent status changed successfully. Returns the updated consent status.

400.description: Bad request - Consent revision is invalid for current acceptance

404.description: Bad request - Consent not found or consent property was empty

401.description: Unauthorized - User not logged in or invalid session

post.description: Marks the specified consent as revoked for the authenticated admin user.

consent.description: The name of the consent to accept

200.description: Consent status changed successfully. Returns the updated consent status.

404.description: Bad request - Consent not found or consent property was empty

401.description: Unauthorized - User not logged in or invalid session

scopeName.description: The scope of the consent that defines how the identifier is resolved

identifier.description: The resolved identifier of the consent

status.description: The current status of the consent (requested, accepted, revoked)

actor.description: The user name of the user who made the consent decision. null if never updated

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of when the consent status was last updated. null if never updated

acceptedUntil.description: The timestamp until when the consent is accepted. null if never accepted

acceptedRevision.description: The accepted consent revision. null unless the consent is currently accepted for a revision-aware consent.

latestRevision.description: The current latest revision defined for the consent. null when the consent does not use revisions.
